title: Sensor Response-Time Reduction using Long-Short Term Memory Network Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2404.17144v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The response time of a biosensor is a crucial metric in safety-critical applications such as medical diagnostics where an earlier diagnosis can markedly improve patient outcomes. However, the speed at which a biosensor reaches a final equilibrium state can be limited by poor mass transport and long molecular diffusion times that increase the time it takes target molecules to reach the active sensing region of a biosensor. While optimization of system and sensor design can promote molecules reaching the sensing element faster, a simpler and complementary approach for response time reduction that is widely applicable across all sensor platforms is to use time-series forecasting to predict the ultimate steady-state sensor response. In this work, we show that ensembles of long short-term memory (LSTM) networks can accurately predict equilibrium biosensor response from a small quantity of initial time-dependent biosensor measurements, all

translated_title: 利用长短期记忆网络预测缩短传感器响应时间
translated_abstract: 生物传感器的响应时间是医疗诊断等安全关键应用中的一项关键指标，在这些应用中，更早的诊断能够显著改善患者的治疗效果。然而，生物传感器达到最终平衡状态的速度可能受到质量传输不佳和分子扩散时间较长的限制，这些因素会增加目标分子到达生物传感器活性感应区域所需的时间。虽然优化系统和传感器设计可以促进分子更快地到达传感元件，但一种更简单且可广泛应用于所有传感器平台的响应时间缩短方法是使用时间序列预测来预测最终的稳态传感器响应。在这项工作中，我们证明了长短期记忆（LSTM）网络的集成方法能够从少量的初始随时间变化的生物传感器测量数据中准确预测平衡状态的生物传感器响应。
tldr: 本文提出利用长短期记忆（LSTM）网络集成方法，仅从少量初始时序生物传感器测量数据即可准确预测最终的稳态响应，从而有效缩短生物传感器的响应时间。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates that ensembles of long short-term memory (LSTM) networks can accurately predict the equilibrium biosensor response from a small quantity of initial time-series measurements, thereby significantly reducing biosensor response time.
